performance.selection_rule: Select the fastest of full and conservative-local only if its selected sequence and final mask equal full and its final candidate-weight maximum absolute error is <=1e-12. Cached adjacency-only invalidation is diagnostic and cannot be selected without a broader correctness proof.

growth_campaign.comparison_protocol: Pair all alpha and policy comparisons by identical continuous seed geometry, orientation, event count, and RNG seed. Treat RNG seeds as numerical realizations, not experimental replicates. Alpha-zero must reproduce the no-orientation model exactly.

acceptance.claim_boundary: Numerical interface and covariance only; no calibrated NaCl kinetics or morphology validation.
